cd /app/output && python3 -m http.server 8080 &
sleep 1
echo "Server started"
# Validate HTML structure with basic checks
echo "=== Checking index.html ==="
grep -c "<header" index.html
grep -c "hero" index.html
grep -c "trending" index.html
grep -c "faq" index.html
grep -c "footer" index.html
grep -c "email-form" index.html
grep -c "carousel" index.html
grep -c "faq-accordion\|faq-item" index.html
grep -c "JSON-LD\|ld+json" index.html

echo "=== Checking login.html ==="
grep -c "login-card" login.html
grep -c "help-section" login.html
grep -c "toggleHelp" login.html
grep -c "JSON-LD\|ld+json" login.html

echo "=== Checking SEO files ==="
test -f robots.txt && echo "robots.txt exists"
test -f sitemap.xml && echo "sitemap.xml exists"
test -f favicon.svg && echo "favicon.svg exists"

# Kill server
pkill -f "python3 -m http.server 8080" || true

steps.message:
All files have been created and validated. Here's a summary of what was built:

## Output Files (`/app/output/`)

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Main landing page with all 7 sections |
| `login.html` | Minimal centered login page |
| `robots.txt` | SEO crawler directives |
| `sitemap.xml` | Site map with both pages |
| `favicon.svg` | Red play-button favicon |

---

## `index.html` Sections
1. **Header** — StreamWave logo (red), language selector, red "Sign In" button linking to `login.html`
2. **Hero** — Full-bleed mosaic background with dark gradient overlay, bold headline, pricing, dual email capture forms (hero + bottom CTA)
3. **Trending** — Horizontal scrollable carousel with large translucent rank numbers (1–10), arrow navigation on desktop, touch-swipeable on mobile
4. **Features** — 4 responsive cards (TV, Download, Watch Everywhere, Kids Profiles) with gradient backgrounds and icons
5. **FAQ** — 6-item accordion with smooth expand/collapse; only one open at a time
6. **CTA** — Repeated email capture for conversion
7. **Footer** — Full link grid, language selector, reCAPTCHA notice

## `login.html` Sections
1. **Header** — Logo only (minimal)
2. **Login Form** — Centered card with email/mobile + password fields, "Continue" button, form validation
3. **Get Help Toggle** — Expandable section with help links beneath the form
4. **Footer** — Matching footer link grid

## SEO & Technical
- **JSON-LD structured data**: WebSite, Organization, and FAQPage schemas
- **Open Graph + Twitter Cards** on both pages
- **Canonical URLs** set
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first CSS, works from 360px to 1440px+
- **Dark mode only**: Deep blacks (`#000000`), rich red accent (`#E50914`), crisp white text
- **No build step**: Pure HTML/CSS/JS, opens directly in any browser
- **Inter font** from Google Fonts for clean, bold typography
